fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that an unidentified customer allegedly took grocery stock worth Rs. 3,50,000 from Sakthi Auto Spares near Vennila Puram Shopping Complex. The matter was brought to Erode South PS on 2025-10-21, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-21 at about 18:30. The complainant, Bhuvana Raman, provided the contact number 9000000251. The complainant is associated with the business Sakthi Auto Spares. The complainant noted the registration number TN-58-YY-1085 of a white scooter. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Arun Selvam (9000000377), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant mentioned a vehicle observation, CCTV footage and physical documents. This matter may be connected to FIR-2026-00199, where the same vehicle registration TN-58-YY-1085 was also mentioned.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Vehicle observation; CCTV footage; Physical document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Goods reportedly taken in a bag during peak hours. A scooter was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, vehicle observation, scooter, CCTV, evening, associate, shopping complex
